set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { status: if (vars.dbHealth == 'UP' and vars.notifyHealth == 'UP') 'UP' else 'DEGRADED', sysDb: vars.dbHealth, sysNotification: vars.notifyHealth }]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/flags/late', query: { reportType: p('report.type'), entityCode: p('report.entityCode') } }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import nextCutoff, ts from dwl::report output application/json --- payload map ($ ++ { businessDate: (ts(nextCutoff($.flaggedAt, p('report.cutoffTime'))) as Date) as String, action: "POST /runs {\"mode\":\"REVISION\",\"reportDate\":\"" ++ ((ts(nextCutoff($.flaggedAt, p('report.cutoffTime'))) as Date) as String) ++ "\"}" })

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries import sha256Hex from dwl::report output application/java --- { fileName: payload.fileName, checksum: sha256Hex(fromBase64((payload.contentBase64 default "") replace /\s+/ with "")) }

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/archive', query: if (isEmpty(vars.presented.fileName)) {} else { fileName: vars.presented.fileName } }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var match = (payload filter ($.checksum == vars.presented.checksum))[0] --- { verified: match != null, checksum: vars.presented.checksum, fileName: match.fileName, runId: match.runId, fileType: match.fileType, archivedAt: match.createdAt, message: if (match != null) "Byte-for-byte identical to the archived " ++ match.fileType ++ " of run " ++ match.runId else if (not isEmpty(vars.presented.fileName) and not isEmpty(payload)) "NOT VERIFIED - a file named " ++ vars.presented.fileName ++ " was issued, but these bytes differ from it (modified or corrupted)" else "NOT VERIFIED - no archived report has this checksum" }

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/chain', query: { reportType: p('report.type'), entityCode: p('report.entityCode') } }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries import sha256Hex from dwl::report output application/java --- vars.archiveSums ++ { (vars.linkRunId): sha256Hex(fromBase64(payload.contentBase64)) }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import chainHash from dwl::report output application/json var links = vars.links var known = links.chainHash default [] var details = links map ((l) -> { runId: l.runId, reportDate: l.reportDate, sequenceNumber: l.sequenceNumber, archiveIntact: vars.archiveSums[l.runId] == l.fileChecksum, linkIntact: chainHash(l.prevChainHash, l.fileChecksum) == l.chainHash, connected: (l.prevChainHash == "GENESIS") or (known contains l.prevChainHash) }) var broken = details filter (not ($.archiveIntact and $.linkIntact and $.connected)) var genesisCount = sizeOf(links filter ($.prevChainHash == "GENESIS")) --- { valid: isEmpty(broken) and (isEmpty(links) or genesisCount == 1), linksChecked: sizeOf(links), brokenAt: broken[0].runId, details: details }
